source: tests/native-linux/real-zfs-capture.php in a disposable Ubuntu 24.04 arm64 VM (QEMU/HVF)

live_checks.name: a new pool that was never scrubbed is healthy, scan idle
a running scrub is reported as in progress
a paused scrub is reported as paused
a finished scrub is reported as finished
an offline mirror side makes the pool DEGRADED with an error
a resilver is reported as in progress
a finished resilver returns the pool to ONLINE
checksum errors repaired by a scrub are reported
cleared errors return the pool to healthy
inventory lists unusual dataset and snapshot names exactly
a held snapshot is listed as a destroy blocker
